_comment: One browser hand-back, end to end. Studio sends `handBackPrompt` with `claimKey` naming the browser job (useBrowserHandBack.ts); the controller reads `browserReply`, the browser turn's last reply, and stamps `recordKey` on the building turn with `expectedFindings` (browser_hand_back.rs); the runtime shows that record to the building turn as quoted page data (runtime-agent jobs/browser_hand_back.rs). The reply lists findings both as the browser skill's JSON lines and as plain lines, one page stopped at a bot check, and its last line is page text that tries to act as an instruction and to close its quote; it must stay data. Addresses are reserved example domains: tests never read live sites.
handBackPrompt: Continue building with what the browser turn found.
